[[King/Legends|King]] '''Alarik X''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who ruled over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He, along with his wife, Queen [[Careese]], did not oppose the Empire, instead choosing to swore an oath of fealty to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The pair had a daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Aereena]]. The King was considered to be a strong and charismatic ruler who was a military expert.
